doc.Subtitle: The reason why I have this website.
doc.Title: On This Website
doc.Content:
Do you remember that great idea, the spark of brilliance that you had last year? Well, I don’t, but I’m about to change that. I want a place where I can note down all of my ideas - the greats, the crazy, and the mundane. I also want a place where I can showcase my side projects, my accomplishments, and also my socials (for networking events). 

 

The solution? This website.
